title: Pagebound
shortDescription: A desktop app that turns scanned book pages into PDF and Kindle-ready EPUB ebooks.
description: A local Python desktop app built with PySide6. Import JPG, PNG or WEBP page scans (or whole folders), preview, reorder and rotate pages, add a cover and book details, then export an image-based PDF, a fixed-layout EPUB 3 or both. Everything runs on your own computer.
